title.narrative: Industrial Corridor Development Program (Subprogram 1)

description.narrative: The proposed program will expand and enhance the competitiveness of manufacturing in India by supporting the development of industrial corridors. The program is consistent with the country partnership strategy for India, 2018 2022; accelerating inclusive economic transformation. Addressing pillar 1 of the country partnership strategy on boosting economic competitiveness and creating jobs, the program will expand multi-modal transport networks along economic corridors, enhance institutions for corridor management, and address skills gaps to support industrialization.

title.narrative: Project/Program Completion Report
Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Apr 30, 2020 - Jan 31, 2022

description.narrative:
Action 1: GoI expanded the National Industrial Corridor Development Program of India by including 6 additional corridors to the existing 5 corridors and expanded the institutional mandate of NICDCL as national program development agency and knowledge partner of NICDIT. Target date: 2022-01-31
Action 2: Skill Development Training programs developed jointly by NICDCL and NSDC to upgrade skills of local labor force within the industrial corridors in line with industry demand with focus on female labor. Target date: 2022-01-31
Action 1: MoCI will launch the NMP-MMC which includes integrated multimodal connectivity to link economic zones with transport and logistics infrastructure and (i) will establish an EGoS comprising senior officials of central ministries for coordinated implementation of NMP-MMC, and (ii) will establish a Network Planning Group for assisting EGoS in coordination and implementation of integrated multimodal network which will enable coordination of plans submitted by various ministries and states. Target date: 2024-12-31

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Feb 01, 2022 - Dec 31, 2024

description.narrative:
Policy 1: Reform Area 1: Institutional structures and mechanisms for industrial corridors' integrated development strengthened. Outcome 1: Investment commitments by public and private sector in industrial corridors increased. From FY2020 to FY2025 by 60%. (FY2020 baseline commitments: $1.33 billion)
Action 2: NICDIT will establish partnerships with at least three new state-level entities through SPVs enhancing the institutional coordination mechanism for efficient collaboration between the center and state. Target date: 2024-12-31

Action 4: GoI will be launching a geospatially-enabled dashboard/portal of NMP-MMC which will have information on infrastructure projects to facilitate transparent and uniform availability of information for the use of investors and multiple government agencies. Target date: 2024-12-31

title.narrative: Policy 3 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Apr 30, 2020 - Jan 31, 2022

description.narrative:
Policy 3: Reform Area 3: Integrated investment in industrial corridors facilitated and promoted. Outcome 1: Ease of doing business improved as evidenced by reduced number of days in (i) government approvals, (ii) processing investment proposals (2020 baseline: Not available)
Action 2: NICDCL issued Instructions to all nodes to make available industrial infrastructure and land related information in IILB portal of DPIIT—that addresses transparency and ease of availability of information for the investors. Target date: 2022-01-31
Action 3: NICDCL formulated a marketing plan and communicated to SPVs to facilitate private sector investment including in social and infrastructure projects that includes: (i) market extension program to attract private sector investment in potential opportunities; and (ii) Awareness building on digital platforms to share potential investment information. Target date: 2022-01-31
Action 4: DPIIT launched an upgraded IPRS, a digital platform, to (i) enhance transparency of information for investors in making selections on investment locations; and (ii) promote competition among Industrial Park owners/states to improve physical infrastructure as well as ease regulatory barriers. Target date: 2022-01-31
Action 5: NICDCL board approved guidelines on skills upgrading and training relevant for employment to nodes within industrial corridors to skill local labor force in industrial areas, based on a gender sensitive needs assessment and available market opportunities. Target date: 2022-01-31
Action 1: DPIIT will integrate line ministries, national and state level agencies, by joining at least 14 states to the single window clearance system platform mechanism. Target date: 2024-12-31
